verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a public REST API and an OpenAPI JSON spec exist (lobe-chat-docs-10, lobe-chat-docs-39, lobe-chat-probe-3), but nothing describes an interactive reference UI (e.g., Swagger/Redoc explorer) or runnable/try-it-now examples for developers to execute calls in-browser. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer UI, in-docs runnable request examples, and any user/community confirmation of trying it.
